notes: Projection = full house-to-front dimension with NO overhang. House stringer, rafters, and front beam/gutter all fit within projection.
Default box-perimeter internal rafters use 80x50 unless overridden.
Default aluminium stock length = 6.0m for cut optimisation.
Acrylic roofing is held by aluminium joiners fixed to rafters; no roofing screws/washers.
Added roof_type gable + hip, mixed roof options (acrylic+timber), and ridge length rules for hip. v1 assumptions; calibrate later.
v1.3: Added pitch input + sloped rafter length + corner hip algorithm notes; updated acrylic to use sloped lengths.

hip_roof.ridge_length_m_formula: max(0, length_m - projection_m)  # assumes 45° hips and ridge runs along length
hip_roof.hip_run_m_formula: (projection_m / 2) * sqrt(2)  # plan run for each hip rafter to ridge end

roof_pitch_deg.description: Roof pitch angle from horizontal. If omitted, use defaults by roof_type.

hip_corner.description: Corner hip (wrap-around) = two pitched wings meeting at corner; uses Length A/Proj A and Length B/Proj B.
derived_algorithm_v1: Wing A rafter positions: x_i = i*s for i=0..ceil(length_a/s).
Wing B rafter positions: y_j = j*s for j=0..ceil(length_b/s).
Hip line in plan from house corner (0,0) to outer corner (projection_b, projection_a): y = (projection_a/projection_b)*x.
Wing A jack rafters: for x_i <= projection_b, plan_run_y = (projection_a/projection_b)*x_i; else plan_run_y = projection_a.
Wing B jack rafters: for y_j <= projection_a, plan_run_x = (projection_b/projection_a)*y_j; else plan_run_x = projection_b.
Convert to sloped lengths: lenA_i = plan_run_y / cos(pitch_a); lenB_j = plan_run_x / cos(pitch_b).
Hip rafter plan length = sqrt(projection_a^2 + projection_b^2). Sloped length approx = hip_plan / cos(avg_pitch).
notes: This produces a rafter schedule (many short jack rafters near the corner). For v1 cost model, you may sum total linear metres and count rafters.
If pitch_a != pitch_b or projections differ, hip line and lengths still work using the same intersection line; validate with drawings before locking.

effective_span_m_by_roof_type.hip: projection_m / 2  # hip common rafters treated as half-span like gable

sheet_2x3.notes: Use when rafter_length_m <= 3.05m. Cut into 620mm strips to suit bay_count. Orientation chosen by rule to reduce sheet count.

strip_620.notes: Use when rafter_length_m > 3.05m. Select the smallest strip length >= rafter_length_m; warn if rafter_length_m > 6.

joiner_system.joiner_count: rafter_count  # one joiner line per rafter

rubbers.notes: Assumes rubbers on both sides of each joiner for both top and bottom pieces. Tune once confirmed.

fasteners.notes: No screws/washers through acrylic. Joiner-to-rafter fixings are counted as a placeholder in hardware_placeholders.

notes: v1.3: use rafter_length_m (sloped) for acrylic strip length selection and joiner cut length; requires pitch.

timber.notes: Timber roof takeoff: lineal metres = roof_area_m2 / cover_m, then apply waste_factor. Costed from pricebook item (per lm).

ridge_skylight.description: Timber roof with one or more 620mm acrylic strips as a skylight running along the ridge (Johanna Smith example).
ridge_skylight.joiner_edge_metres_formula: strip_count * 2 * strip_length_m  # edges only; not full-roof joiner grid

area_override.description: User provides acrylic_area_m2 directly (e.g., custom skylight).

timber_remainder.note: Timber costing remains manual in v1 unless timber pricebook is added.

details: gable: ridge along length; rafters counted both sides (2x rafter_count); ridge_length_m = length_m
hip: ridge_length_m = max(0, length_m - projection_m) (assumes 45° hips); add 4 hip rafters; jack trimming handled via labour multiplier for now
